Yes, this is supported as a small onboarding change.

Current behavior:
- `Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup` creates or updates one open `Sepo setup check` issue in [`.agent/src/onboarding.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/onboarding.ts#L100-L129).
- It already creates Sepo trigger labels and `agent-goal` in [`.agent/src/onboarding.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/onboarding.ts#L306-L322).
- The plain `agent` label is already the existing non-trigger status label, documented separately from `agent/*` trigger labels in [supported workflows](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md#L281-L294).
- There is already a scheduled stale closer that closes open issues with the `agent` label after 30 inactive days in [`.github/workflows/agent-close-stale-issues.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-close-stale-issues.yml#L31-L47).

Recommended implementation:
1. Update onboarding to ensure the fixed `agent` status label exists.
2. Apply `agent` to the `Sepo setup check` issue after create/update.
3. Keep using the existing reusable setup-check issue/comment pattern.
4. Add tests in [`.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts) to assert the label is created/applied.
5. Update docs to say the setup-check issue is agent-tracked.

For automatic closing: adding `agent` makes it eligible for the existing stale-close workflow after 30 days of inactivity. If you want a stronger behavior, we can also add explicit “close when setup is complete” logic in onboarding, but I’d treat that as a separate choice because the setup issue is useful as a reusable status surface for reruns.

Please approve whether to implement just the `agent` label tracking, or also add explicit close-on-complete behavior.

Sepo is dispatching follow-up automation.
